card.name: Linking words before drug or lesion lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, or, with, an, oral, prior, a comma) that come right before the next item in a list of drugs or imaging findings. Seen in label text on ARIA, NSAID co-medications and gout prophylaxis.

modes.label: Joining co-medications
modes.description: A comma, or, an, or oral inside a list of drug classes taken together.
modes.example: concurrent prophylactic treatment with colchicine<< or>> an anti-inflammatory agent is recommended
